purpose: Zero-label source, license, timestamp, identity, coverage, history, stability and cost inventory for C1-C7 STOP_DATA_COVERAGE recovery.

common_root_causes.issue: No single durable contract currently proves source observed_at, available_at, event_time and revision lineage for every candidate input.
Fixture/club/player identities are not uniformly cross-provider, cross-competition and kickoff-revision aware.
All 17 formal domains are not simultaneously covered by timestamp-safe sources for each expert family.
Several public archives are retrospective/static or currently stale; retrieval time must not be backfilled as historical availability time.

C1.license_or_terms: commercial API terms; raw-feed resale/competing redistribution restricted; research/model use documented by prior contract audit
C1.timestamp_semantics: provider snapshots plus bookmaker last_update are suitable in principle; no acquired rows exist
C1.competition_coverage: 17/17 routes mapped, but multi-line alternate totals coverage is not proven across all 17
C1.fixture_identity: provider_event_id plus canonical competition/team identity and kickoff revision lineage required
C1.historical_depth: featured markets from 2020-06-06; additional markets from 2023-05-03
C1.stability: documented historical snapshot service; paid/API dependent
current_blockers: existing collector normalizes only one featured totals line per bookmaker

C2.fixture_identity: current team id is competition-scoped; global canonical club id and season membership lineage missing
C2.historical_depth: Transfermarkt config covers seasons 2012-2025; OpenFootball has multi-season lower-division histories and exact 2025/26 Big5 second-tier pins; current Transfermarkt snapshot stops 2026-07-06
C2.stability: Transfermarkt automated updates paused; historical snapshot remains available
current_blockers: Big5 lower-division result files are publicly pinned but cannot be consumed until deterministic cross-provider club identity bindings are materialized
fixed 1500 cold-start is synthetic rather than evidence
